steps.note: an icon drawn with the Pen on a blank white canvas, which is the case the whole question is about: the white is a real full size bitmap under the shape
the file Export writes by default: the log line above says nothing behind the drawing, so the icon can be dropped on a coloured page or a dark theme without a white box round it
the same drawing asked for with the canvas in it: the log line names the colour that went into the file, and the file is bigger by exactly one rectangle
the Export sheet on SVG: under what the file will be there is Include the background, unticked, with a swatch of the colour that would go in and a line saying the file sits on any colour
ticked: the line under it changes to say the canvas colour is painted behind the drawing, so which file you are about to save is readable before you save it
